svg.title: Thermal programming of phase architecture, dissolution, pH and cytocompatibility (700 vs 1100 °C)
svg.desc: Four panels: A phase composition and bulk density vs temperature; B mass loss vs immersion time with Korsmeyer-Peppas fits; C interfacial pH; D cell viability vs extract concentration.
svg.text: Kinetic Blueprint · Thermal Programming of Phase Architecture and Ion Release
Ca–Si–P–O bioactive glass-ceramics · 700 °C vs 1100 °C processing · phase assemblage → dissolution → interfacial pH → cytocompatibility
21 d mass loss 10.2% vs 2.6% (≈4× faster at 700 °C)
700 °C peaks at pH 8.55; 1100 °C stays in window

text.tspan: Ca : Si ≈ 3.0 at both temperatures · ≈4× higher release at 700 °C
